responsibility: Contains the conditional-computation machine descriptions for the M32C port: compares, conditional branches, setcc/cstore patterns, conditional moves of constants, and conversion of flags to integer results. A central role of this file is preserving compare-and-use flag dependencies across reload by using insn-and-split patterns, then lowering them to explicit compare plus branch/setcc forms after reload, while also supplying peepholes and compare output hooks used by the backend’s flag-sensitive control-flow generation.
